idea.idea: The danger of AI agents in IT infrastructure
idea.angle: Why you need to audit your IT vendors like ConnectWise for agent-based security breaches.
idea.audience_problem: Small businesses rely on third-party IT providers who might be using vulnerable AI tools.

hooks: Your IT vendor might be the biggest security risk to your small business.
Chinese hackers just used AI to breach 2,000 businesses in one week.
If you use ConnectWise for backups, your data link might be compromised.
piece.hook_reason: It hits the specific pain point of the target audience (trusting external vendors) immediately and provides a clear, actionable reason to pay attention.

piece.caption: Your small business IT setup depends on third-party vendors. If they get hacked, your data is at risk. Recent reports show attackers used AI to breach thousands of organizations through a single IT management giant, ConnectWise. These attackers used an open-source framework called ARTEX to automate thousands of login attempts per minute, making manual defense nearly impossible. Don't assume your IT provider is fully secure. Contact your IT vendor today and specifically ask if they use ConnectWise and what multi-factor authentication (MFA) protocols they have in place to prevent unauthorized access to your cloud backups. It is better to ask tough questions now than to deal with a data breach later. #CyberSecurity #SMBTips #ITSecurity #BusinessOwners #DataProtection

visual_issues: Scene 2: The diagram is too abstract; it lacks visual hierarchy and doesn't clearly show the 'breach' point.
Scene 5: The checklist uses green checkmarks, which implies these items are already done/safe, rather than questions to ask. This is confusing for a call-to-action.
issues: The narration in Scene 4 feels slightly disconnected from the visual, which is a bit text-heavy.
The call-to-action in the final scene is visually misleading due to the use of checkmarks.
review.fix_instructions: 1. In Scene 2, replace the generic boxes with a more descriptive flow chart showing the 'ConnectWise Cloud' as the entry point. 2. In Scene 5, change the green checkmarks to empty checkboxes or question mark icons to correctly signal that these are questions the user needs to ask their vendor. 3. Ensure the narration in Scene 4 flows more naturally into the final checklist scene.
